title: Settlement Basis: Charges Already Withheld Carried into the Revised Price of a Vacation Package
content:
Where amendment or penalty charges already stand on the ledger of a package among the Vacation Package Products, some or all of them may be carried into the revised price. The charges counted are the amendment and penalty charges standing against that package, totalled with their signs; they stand against the package where that total is above nil.

**Where the package stands at confirmed.** Where the package ledger carries an amendment or penalty charge and the package record stands at confirmed, the charges already withheld are carried into the revised price in full.

**Where the package stands at deposit held.** Where the package ledger carries an amendment or penalty charge and the package record stands at deposit held, the charges already withheld are carried into the revised price at the part-paid share published for this calculation, which is 50 per cent.

**Otherwise.** Where the total of such charges is nil, or the package record stands at anything other than confirmed or deposit held, no carry of this kind is made into the revised price.

| Amendment and penalty charges standing against the package | Package record stands at | Carried into the revised price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| total above nil | confirmed | the whole of that total |
| total above nil | deposit held | that total taken at 50 per cent |
| total above nil | quoted, travelling, completed, cancelled or closed | none of this kind |
| total of nil | any | none of this kind |

*Worked hypothetically.* A package whose ledger carries amendment and penalty charges totalling 300.00 USD carries 300.00 USD into the revised price where the record stands at confirmed, and 150.00 USD where it stands at deposit held.
